This app uses MobileVLCKit 3.6.0, by the VideoLAN and VLCKit contributors,
and its bundled libVLC, by the VideoLAN and VLC contributors. MobileVLCKit
and libVLC are provided under the GNU Lesser General Public License version
2.1 or later. A copy of version 2.1 is provided in COPYING.LGPL-2.1.

The source, build script and VLC patches for this MobileVLCKit version are at:
https://github.com/videolan/vlckit/tree/c73b779f2d1e3d3c1598a27811679ce2c1a005db

The corresponding VLC source used by that build is at:
https://github.com/videolan/vlc/tree/dd8bfdbabe8ae3974ca3864ad3125879f523e3a2

The MobileVLCKit binary comes from VideoLAN's 3.6.0 distribution and is
repackaged as an XCFramework by vlckit-spm without changes to the source:
https://download.videolan.org/pub/cocoapods/prod/MobileVLCKit-3.6.0-c73b779f-dd8bfdba.tar.xz
https://github.com/tylerjonesio/vlckit-spm/releases/tag/3.6.0

MobileVLCKit is linked dynamically. You may build a modified, compatible
arm64 MobileVLCKit.framework, replace the copy in the app's Frameworks
directory, and sign the modified app for use on your device. You may also
build this app from source with the modified XCFramework in Vendor/VLCKit.
